description: Jamaica and Haiti - Hurricane Melissa Road Blockages is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Planetary Response Network. This is a point dataset of road blockages in Jamaica and Haiti following Hurricane Melissa. The road blockages are marked by a single point, alongside the type of damage e.g. debris, flooding or coastal damage. The data is held in a shapefile format using the WGS 84 EPSG: 4326 projection. Coverage: Haiti, Jamaica. The portal files it under the publisher Planetary Response Network. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, damage assessment, logistics, roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-12-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
